background_story: Jeremias was a brilliant linguist who spent his career studying the intricacies of language. His area of expertise was intrasentential relations, where he delved into the complex web of relationships within sentences. His groundbreaking research on clause structure and semantic roles earned him international recognition. Jeremias's passion for language was contagious, and his students adored him for his ability to break down complex concepts into digestible bits. As he navigated the academic world, Jeremias remained humble and kind, always willing to lend a helping hand to his colleagues. His love for language was not limited to the theoretical; he was also an avid reader and writer, often spending his free time lost in the pages of a good novel or crafting his own short stories.
